mapper.select: SELECT oi.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec, m.unit, COALESCE(l.image_url, m.image_url) AS image_url FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.store_id = o.store_id AND l.seller_sku = oi.seller_sku LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = oi.material_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id

SELECT oi.id, oi.order_id, oi.seller_sku, oi.title, oi.qty, oi.bundle, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, COALESCE(l.image_url, m.image_url) AS image_url FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN ecom_listing l ON l.store_id = o.store_id AND l.seller_sku = oi.seller_sku LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = oi.material_id WHERE oi.order_id IN #{id} ORDER BY oi.order_id, oi.id
